description: The file defines the class Zend_Registry, a singleton storage class for managing global data and shared objects in a PHP application, with methods for setting, getting, and managing registry entries.

classes.name: Zend_Registry
classes.description: A singleton class extending ArrayObject that provides global storage for objects and data, enabling shared access throughout an application.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Zend_Registry, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setInstance
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of Zend_Registry to a specified object.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name used to instantiate the default registry object, dynamically loading the class if needed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry using a specified key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the registry under a specified key.

methods.name: isRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a particular key is registered in the registry.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the registry object, extending ArrayObject with optional default data.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a registry key exists, implementing custom logic for key existence.
